Runtime code of canonical third-party contracts deployed on Base, for etching onto a LOCAL anvil (anvil_setCode) in the
app-funded lease tests. These are not builds of this repository and are not deployed by it.
  aa-code-base.json    ERC-4337 v0.8 EntryPoint 0x4337084D9E255Ff0702461CF8895CE9E3b5Ff108, its SenderCreator, and
                       Simple7702Account 0xe6Cae83BdE06E4c305530e199D7217f42808555B - the addresses relay/host-sponsor.mjs
                       and windows/node/sponsor.mjs pin (ENTRYPOINT_08, SIMPLE_7702)
  safe-code-base.json  Safe v1.4.1 SafeL2 0x29fcB43b46531BcA003ddC8FCB67FFE91900C762 and SafeProxyFactory
                       0x4e1DCf7AD4e460CfD30791CCC4F9c8a4f820ec67, plus the factory's proxy creation code
  safe-passkey-code-base.json  every contract site/js/core/account-providers.js pins for the "safe-passkey" provider (Safe
                       v1.4.1, Safe passkey signer v0.2.1 factory/shared signer, Daimo P-256 verifier, Safe4337Module,
                       module setup, EntryPoint v0.7, MultiSend/MultiSendCallOnly), each stored code hashing to its reviewed
                       codeHash pin, plus the passkey signer singleton the pinned factory names (no pin of its own: its
                       address is embedded in the factory's pinned code, its bytes are two-RPC agreed). Read by
                       test/helpers/safe-passkey-code.mjs for the site Safe/passkey tests, which no longer read Base.
Each entry records the address, the Base block it was read at, both public RPCs (which had to return identical bytes),
the byte length, and keccak256 (= the chain's EXTCODEHASH) and sha256 of the code. Anyone can re-check an entry with
eth_getCode at that block, or re-take the snapshot: scripts/test-fixtures/snapshot-aa-code.mjs, snapshot-safe-code.mjs,
snapshot-safe-passkey-code.mjs
(read-only: eth_blockNumber/eth_getCode/eth_call only, no key, no transaction). test/lease-gas-fixtures.test.mjs checks
the recorded hashes against the stored code.
